verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only developer building blocks: Drive API push notifications that tell an application when a watched resource changes, plus developer samples such as creating files from Form submissions. None of it documents a product-level way for users to define event-triggered rules that run actions automatically. These primitives would let a developer build such automation, but that earns no credit toward the story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
